raw_market.question: 4Q Spread: Packers (-6.5)
raw_market.description:
In the fourth quarter of the NFL game between Bears and Packers, scheduled for October 11 at 4:25 PM ET:

This market will resolve to "Packers" if the Packers outscore the Bears by 7 or more points in the fourth quarter.

Otherwise, this market will resolve to "Bears".

Only points scored during that period count; overtime is not included.

If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed. If the game is canceled entirely, with no make-up game, this market will resolve 50-50.
